body.heading: Where in the world is Israel?
paragraphs: Israel is a country in Western Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Israel is Jerusalem. Jerusalem is one of the oldest and most storied cities in the world, sacred to three religions — Judaism, Christianity and Islam.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Israel speak Hebrew and Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Israel is the Israeli new shekel.

body.heading: How big is Israel?
paragraphs: Israel covers about 21,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Lebanon.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Jerusalem's Old City holds sacred sites of three faiths within ancient walls — the Western Wall, the Church of the Holy Sepulchre and the golden Dome of the Rock.
Ride a cable car to Masada, a fortress-palace on a flat desert mountain above the Dead Sea, built by King Herod and famous for its last stand in history.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Israel on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Israel in one breath: a country in Western Asia, capital Jerusalem, where people speak Hebrew and pay with the Israeli new shekel.
